headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI and strong dividend payouts.
summary: Most major players reported double‑digit revenue growth YoY. TCS led with 15.4% growth and a 24% operating margin. HCLTech and Tech Mahindra also posted healthy gains, while AI revenue is emerging as a key catalyst. Dividend payouts were raised at LTM and TCS, reflecting confidence in cash generation.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI sales contributed to double‑digit revenue growth at HCLTech, LTM and Wipro, and AI revenue now exceeds $3 bn for TCS.

themes.title: Dividend strength
themes.detail: Companies increased interim dividends, with LTM paying ₹25 per share and TCS maintaining ₹12 per share.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Operating margins varied widely, from 24% at TCS to sub‑15% at Persistent and Mphasis.

leaders.why: Highest revenue growth (15.4% YoY) and strongest operating margin (24%).
Strong AI sales and solid profit growth (21% YoY).

laggards.why: Margins missed estimates and sentiment is negative despite revenue growth.
Financial results not released, creating uncertainty.
